name: Pulk
summary: Pulk is a delve found in the Grazelands region of Vvardenfell, south of Vos, containing bandits and nix-hounds. Pulk's cave network is currently being used as a hideout by a bandit gang led by Bralsa Inlador. These bandits have targeted the nearby settlements of Molag Mar, Sadrith Mora, and Vos, and you may be sent here on a Hall of Justice to recover stolen taxes and prevent the bandits from pulling off even more heists. Othuk's Hideout can be found in the back of the delve during A Madcap Mystery, through a hidden door behind the waterfall.
notes: Pulk also appears in TES III: Morrowind.
Prior to Update 16, you could be sent to Pulk to track down Bulag Idolus (found hiding on the lower levels) as part of the deprecated quest A Friend In Need.

The bandits have attempted and partially succeeded at taming the resident nix-hounds of the cavern. However as a result, several of them are found in a wounded state, holding their ribs, which makes them slower to draw their weapons when initiating combat.
